title: Control states for find phases
statement: Given a natural number $m$ and a type $A$, assign control states to each find-machine phase: the read phase has control states in $\mathrm{Option}(\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\})$, each scan phase has a scan phase state, each skip phase has a seek phase state, and the exit phase has a singleton control state.
